config.shuffle_rule: label-blind independent row derangement inside fit/stop/calibration/evaluation subsets; values and masks travel together; same map for all seeds; no cross-subset exchange
config.threshold_rule: 90th percentile uncertainty on separate inner calibration patients, no labels; fixed before outer evaluation
config.selection: early stopping on inner stop macro-F1 only; all outer folds reported
config.test_policy: original six test subjects excluded; retrospective development evidence only

evaluation_scope: retrospective original train+val only; each patient outer-held-out exactly once per seed
